source.snippet: Webmasters SE (Nov 2026): 'I manage a site, React on Vercel. Years ago, the same domain ran an older PHP install, and a spam injection on it left Googlebot with several thousand junk URLs... In late October, a rule was deployed that serves 410 Gone for these patterns... I want to accelerate removal from Google's index without manual intervention on thousands of URLs.'

problem_statement: Website owners and SEO managers inheriting domains with legacy spam-injected URLs struggle to efficiently purge thousands of junk paths from Google's index, with no clear automated tooling beyond manual Search Console submissions.
target_segment: SEO specialists and web agencies managing site migrations or legacy domain cleanups for clients.
notes: Professional SEO context ('I manage a site') — agencies pay for SEO tooling. Problem is concrete and recurring across any domain migration or legacy cleanup project. Opportunity: automated bulk URL de-indexing workflow tool. Single signal but highly specific and actionable.
